title: OHCHR documentation of incommunicado detention from Gaza
summary: OHCHR examined the legal status and access restrictions affecting Palestinians detained from Gaza.
claim: OHCHR documented that many Palestinians taken from Gaza were held for prolonged periods without information to their families about their fate or whereabouts and without access to lawyers.
legal_characterization: Documented evidence relevant to alleged arbitrary and incommunicado detention and enforced disappearance; not an adjudication of individual cases.
source_organization: Office of the United Nations High Commissioner for Human Rights
source_title: Detention in the context of the escalation of hostilities in Gaza (7 October 2023 - 30 June 2024)
verification_notes: Verified against the cited sections of the OHCHR thematic report, including its scope and methodology. OHCHR documents accounts and information; this record does not treat every reported incident as an adjudicated finding. Classification judgment: enforced-disappearance relevance is noted conservatively without asserting that all legal elements were established; manual review is requested.
